headline: MIXED Reality News reports that Nvidia graphics cards cost 41% more at EU retailers than in June.
score_reason: Headline only; could not verify the data or method.
importance_line: Gamers and PC builders in the EU may be paying noticeably more for graphics cards, but the retailers sampled and the method behind the figures are not stated in the headline.
summary: MIXED Reality News reports that Nvidia graphics cards are selling for 41% more at EU retailers than in June, and AMD cards for 28% more, in what it describes as a rise "without its reported hike".
notes: Headline only. The AMD wording ("without its reported hike") is ambiguous and is quoted, not interpreted. No other outlet found.
